picks.title: 饥饿游戏：收获日出
picks.titleEn: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
picks.summary: 改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说。故事发生在《饥饿游戏》事件发生前24年，讲述第50届饥饿游戏（第二次四分区叛乱纪念赛）抽签日当天，年轻的黑密斯·阿伯纳西被选中参赛的故事。
picks.summaryEn: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
